verdicts.reason: A: the headline and body copy sit on top of the circle, which is now detached from the shoe. GROVE falls below the headline, the 'Summer Only' pill shrinks to an unreadable speck, and the 'Find It Near You' CTA is pushed small into the bottom-right corner, where the oversized tilted Free Delivery badge outweighs it. B: the body copy is squeezed onto one line too small to read, and GROVE again sits under the headline. The 'Back by Demand' pill is the same size as the CTA, so the two compete, and the shoe hangs off the circle's edge. Still, B's CTA is prominent and the 2x2 button grid has some order, so it is the less broken of the two.
